title: simaba cuspidata var. typica
intro: Simaba cuspidata var. typica, commonly known as the Cupped Simaba or Mexican Prickly Ash, is a plant species native to Mexico and Central America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, with its health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Simaba cuspidata var. typica include pain relief, wound healing, and fever reduction, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins. Research has identified the presence of bioactive compounds like lupane triterpenoids and flavonoids, contributing to its medicinal properties.
